metadata.name: Knowledge writer
metadata.summary: Let an agentic worker create, read, list and remove documents in its own knowledge bases
metadata.description: Design extension exposing four agentic-worker tools: knowledge_create, knowledge_read, knowledge_list and knowledge_remove. They call the host knowledge port (greentic:extension-host/knowledge@0.1.0): the designer decides the tenant, the team and which bases the worker may touch (the bases bound to the worker); the tool only names a base by its name. Text documents only (plain text, markdown, CSV, JSON). Remove drops a document from the base and keeps the library copy. Requires a designer that provides the knowledge port; v1 serves it in Test chat only.

tools.name: knowledge_create
tools.description: Create a text document in one of this worker's knowledge bases.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","required":["knowledge_base","name","text"],"properties":{"knowledge_base":{"type":"string","description":"Name of a knowledge base bound to this worker, exactly as shown on the Knowledge page"},"name":{"type":"string","description":"Display name of the new document"},"text":{"type":"string","description":"Document text: plain text, markdown, CSV or JSON"}}}
tools.output_schema: {"type":"object","required":["ok"],"properties":{"ok":{"type":"boolean"},"document_id":{"type":"string"},"created":{"type":"boolean","description":"false when an identical document already existed and was reused"},"error":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"message":{"type":"string"}}}}}

tools.name: knowledge_read
tools.description: Read one document of one of this worker's knowledge bases.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","required":["knowledge_base","document_id"],"properties":{"knowledge_base":{"type":"string","description":"Name of a knowledge base bound to this worker"},"document_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id from knowledge_list or knowledge_create"}}}

tools.name: knowledge_list
tools.description: List the documents of one of this worker's knowledge bases.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","required":["knowledge_base"],"properties":{"knowledge_base":{"type":"string","description":"Name of a knowledge base bound to this worker"}}}

tools.name: knowledge_remove
tools.description: Remove a document from one of this worker's knowledge bases (the library copy is kept).
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","required":["knowledge_base","document_id"],"properties":{"knowledge_base":{"type":"string","description":"Name of a knowledge base bound to this worker"},"document_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id from knowledge_list or knowledge_create"}}}
tools.output_schema: {"type":"object","required":["ok"],"properties":{"ok":{"type":"boolean"},"removed":{"type":"boolean","description":"false when the document was not in that base"},"error":{"type":"object","properties":{"code":{"type":"string"},"message":{"type":"string"}}}}}
